name: tether
description: Drive a remote Windows machine through Claude Code via a one-shot agent .exe and a cloud relay. Filesystem, shell, registry, event log, screenshots, clipboard, Active Directory, and window control without installing anything beyond the .exe on the remote.

tether.description: Tether MCP server. Spawns one process per Claude Code window and holds the WSS connection to the relay for that session.

commands.name: remote-new
commands.description: Start a new Tether session. Prints the short code; read it aloud to the remote user.

commands.name: remote-list
commands.description: List active Tether sessions held by this Claude Code window.

skills.name: tether
skills.description: Operating manual for the remote agent: when to use which mcp__tether__* tool, narration contract, session targeting, kill-switch handling, Windows path conventions.
